method: glass_probe on the staged glTF (owner ruling: glazing verdict comes from the file, never the sheet or poster)
eye pass on the 4-view production sheet against the owner's per-car rubric
5x zoom against a same-batch known-good control for any wheel suspicion
body_probe to find the real body material before any colour bake

verdicts.name: 2024 Kia Picanto GT-Line
verdicts.reason: sharp LED headlamp internals, defined shut lines, real spoke detail consistent across all four views, black rubber, glazing transparent with interior visible. One of the strongest sheets in the project.

verdicts.name: Kia Sportage GT line 2023
verdicts.reason: correct NQ5 proportions, boomerang DRL signature, honeycomb grille, black tyres, glazing transparent. High-volume UK car.
verdicts.note: glass_probe reports alpha_shell=true — FALSE POSITIVE, verified: 37 of 43 materials are opaque and the 6 transparent ones are exactly window/glass_Clear/glass_tinted/red_glass/light/red_light. The flag fires on `st_black`, a trim material with alphaMode=BLEND but factor alpha 1.0, i.e. declared blend and actually opaque.

verdicts.name: 2025 Skoda Octavia RS
verdicts.reason: correct Mk4 facelift RS, butler's-tray grille with vertical slats, red calipers, SKODA/OCTAVIA/RS badging, real spokes, glazing transparent.
verdicts.note: 2.28M faces — over the standard delivery cap, must go through decimate_heavy before publish.

verdicts.name: 2025 MG ZS
verdicts.reason: correct ZS proportions, MG badge front and rear, real grille mesh, LED lamp internals, black alloys with genuine spoke depth, glazing transparent. Growing UK volume.

verdicts.name: 2025 MG MG4
verdicts.reason: correct MG4 shape, orange brake calipers, black alloys, black tyres, glazing transparent.
verdicts.note: cov=0.758 is high but under the 0.90 one-material-covers-everything line, and the tyres and glazing are visibly unaffected.

verdicts.name: 2025 MG MG3
verdicts.reason: correct Mk3 hybrid+ shape, real 5-spoke alloys resolved in all four views, mesh grille, LED internals, glazing transparent. Used as the same-batch control for the MG5 wheel zoom.

verdicts.name: 2026 Renault Clio
verdicts.reason: genuine new-generation Clio, sharp lamps, real spokes, black tyres, glazing transparent. Held only because no material is NAMED like paint.

repair.found_by: body_probe — 50.0% of the silhouette, 4x the runner-up
repair.evidence: red control repaints body, roof, bonnet and bumpers; wheels stay silver, tyres black, glazing clear, lamps intact. Roof confirmed numerically on the top view: [253.9,253.9,254.3] -> [163.9,21.1,23.7].

not_the_body.Material__2125651335: tyres, arch liners, lower valance, interior (66.1% area)
not_the_body.black_refl: window surrounds, pillars, roof rails, wheel spokes, mirrors
not_the_body.Color_M01: wheel rims — painting it turns the wheels pink

verdicts.name: HYUNDAI I20 2026
verdicts.reason: soft undetailed surfacing throughout, headlamps are flat decals with no internal elements, wheels are crude discs with no spoke depth, and it does not read as an i20 — generic crossover shape. Fails the premium bar on the owner's rubric.

verdicts.name: 2024 Renault Megane E-TECH
verdicts.reason: FRONT WHEEL ABSENT on one side — front34 and side both render an empty arch cavity with the inner arch surface visible. Geometry missing, not a material or lighting artefact. Also only 142k faces, low for a modern car.
verdicts.confidence: high — two independent views, and the sheet is a valid witness for missing geometry (unlike material defects)

verdicts.name: 2025 MG MG5
verdicts.reason: per-side wheel void. At 3x zoom the front34 wheel is a featureless black disc with only the MG centre cap floating in it — rim face entirely absent — while the side view of the same car shows a resolved multi-spoke rim. Same-batch MG3 control shows fully resolved silver spokes in both views.
verdicts.confidence: high — zoomed against a same-batch control per CLAUDE.md, not called from the thumbnail
verdicts.class: mirrored wheel duplicate with inverted geometry (source defect, not a render fault) — re-rendering will not fix it
